open_questions.question: The NEET (UG) 2027 information bulletin and syllabus are not yet published on neet.nta.nic.in or nmc.org.in (checked 2026-10-29). No neet-ug-2027 profile or blueprint is created; re-run exam-blueprint and syllabus-mapper when they are notified.
NTA/NMC have not published a Hindi version of the NEET (UG) 2026 syllabus that we could find. All Hindi strings here are translations (hi_source: translation).
